frontend_web/src/utils/browserMobileOtp..rationale: Named browser mobile OTP transport wrapper delegates canonical API_ENDPOINTS.mobileVerifyOtp to its established app-specific Axios interceptor. This boundary preserves browser cookie/CSRF fallback, existing bearer refresh and session-clear behaviour, and returns identical .data DTO. UI is free of literal domain request URLs; platform-dependent HTTP auth is intentional and audited, not a business/policy bypass.
